cues.en: Mike: Now I'm going to introduce you to the Mann-Whitney U test, which as you'll see in a moment, has several different names.
cues.zh: Mike：現在介紹 Mann–Whitney U 檢定，等一下會看到它有好幾個名稱。

cues.en: It is also a non-parametric t-test.
cues.zh: 也是無母數 t 檢定。

cues.en: So it's a little bit similar to the Wilcoxon signed-rank test that I introduced a few videos ago.
cues.zh: 和幾部前介紹的 Wilcoxon 符號等級檢定有點像。

cues.en: So in this case, the Mann-Whitney U test is a non-parametric alternative, but this is only to be used for a two-samples t-test
cues.zh: Mann–Whitney U 是無母數替代，但只用於雙樣本 t 檢定，

cues.en: with unpaired samples.
cues.zh: 且樣本不成對。

cues.en: So independent samples.
cues.zh: 也就是獨立樣本。

cues.en: If you have a two-samples t-test with paired data, then you have to go back and use the signed-rank test.
cues.zh: 雙樣本資料成對時，必須回頭使用符號等級檢定。

cues.en: So not this U test, but the signed-rank test.
cues.zh: 不是 U 檢定，而是符號等級檢定。

cues.en: And again, it's used when the data do not conform to the normality assumption.
cues.zh: 同樣用於資料不符合常態性假設時。

cues.en: And what's also interesting to note here is that the two groups do not need to have the same sample size.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，兩組不需要有相同樣本數。

cues.en: You'll see that in a moment when I get to the algorithm.
cues.zh: 等一下演算法會看到。

cues.en: But the two groups do not need to have the same sample size.
cues.zh: 但兩組不需要有相同樣本數。

cues.en: Alright, so this was a reminder of a slide I showed a few videos ago.
cues.zh: 這是幾部前投影片的複習。

cues.en: So we have the Wilcoxon signed-rank test, which is the same thing as a signed-rank test.
cues.zh: Wilcoxon signed-rank 和符號等級檢定相同。

cues.en: And now we're gonna talk about, what's called, sometimes, it's called the Mann-Whitney U test.
cues.zh: 現在要談，有時稱為 Mann–Whitney U 檢定的方法。

cues.en: Sometimes it's called the Mann-Whitney-Wilcoxon U test.
cues.zh: 有時稱 Mann–Whitney–Wilcoxon U 檢定。

cues.en: I guess that this is the same Wilcoxon as this guy, although I don't know for sure.
cues.zh: 我猜是同一位 Wilcoxon，但不確定。

cues.en: And it's also called the Wilcoxon rank-sum test.
cues.zh: 也叫 Wilcoxon 等級和檢定。

cues.en: Not to be confused with these signed-rank test.
cues.zh: 不要和符號等級檢定混淆。

cues.en: Who could possibly confuse this thing with this thing?
cues.zh: 誰可能把這個和那個混淆呢？

cues.en: And also sometimes people even just call this the U test and drop all of these names altogether.
cues.zh: 有時甚至直接叫 U 檢定，把名字全省掉。

cues.en: So I don't know why things get so confusing and there's so many names, but you know?
cues.zh: 不知道為什麼這麼混亂、名稱這麼多。

cues.en: I'm sorry. You just have to live with it.
cues.zh: 抱歉，只能接受。

cues.en: So again, as a quick reminder, this is a non-parametric alternative for when you have a two-sample t-test scenario with unpaired t-tests,
cues.zh: 快速提醒，這是雙樣本 t 檢定情境的無母數替代，且檢定不成對，

cues.en: or unpaired group, sorry.
cues.zh: 抱歉，是群組不成對。

cues.en: Alright, now I'm gonna walk you through the algorithm to compute the Mann-Whitney U test.
cues.zh: 接著介紹計算 Mann–Whitney U 的演算法。

cues.en: Again, like with the signed-rank test from a few videos ago, this is not an algorithm that I recommend memorizing.
cues.zh: 和前幾部符號等級一樣，不建議背演算法。

cues.en: I don't think you should put this on a tattoo on the back of your hand so that you look at it all the time and eventually memorize it.
cues.zh: 不應把它刺在手背，一直看，最後記住。

cues.en: I'm gonna walk you through this once.
cues.zh: 只會逐步說明一次。

cues.en: You can write it down so that you get the idea and then, that's it.
cues.zh: 可以寫下來，了解概念，就這樣。

cues.en: Then you just know when you need to use this test.
cues.zh: 之後只要知道何時使用。

cues.en: That's the important thing.
cues.zh: 這才重要。

cues.en: Okay, so step one is to write down a bunch of Ns and to separate out the dataset.
cues.zh: 第一步，寫下一堆 N，分開資料集。

cues.en: So the way this algorithm works is actually we need to know which data come from the group with fewer data points and which data come from the group with more data points.
cues.zh: 演算法需要知道，哪些資料來自點數較少的組，哪些來自點數較多的組。

cues.en: So I'm gonna call that subscript f for fewer points, because the data is countable.
cues.zh: 用下標 f，代表 fewer，較少點數，因為資料可數。

cues.en: So we have more and fewer instead of less and more.
cues.zh: 所以英文用 more 和 fewer，而不是 less 和 more。

cues.en: So the group with fewer data points, the group with more points, obviously if you have both of these groups with the same number of samples, then this is arbitrary,
cues.zh: 點數較少的組、較多的組；如果兩組樣本數相同，這就是任意的，

cues.en: and you can just pick whichever.
cues.zh: 隨便選。

cues.en: You could call group f, the group that you expect to be larger, for example.
cues.zh: 例如，可以把預期數值較大的組稱為 f。

cues.en: Okay, so the data sets with fewer or more points and the number of data points.
cues.zh: 資料集點數較少或較多，以及資料點數。

cues.en: So the sample sizes for the smaller data set and for the larger data sets, the data with fewer points and the data with more points.
cues.zh: 也就是較小、較大資料集的樣本大小，點數少和點數多的資料。

cues.en: Okay, so that's step one.
cues.zh: 這是第一步。

cues.en: Step two is to pool the data together and then compute the rank.
cues.zh: 第二步，合併資料，再計算秩。

cues.en: Now, this is important, because we are pooling all of the data together, but in this particular order.
cues.zh: 很重要，是合併全部資料，但按照這個特定順序。

cues.en: So we can concatenate first the group with the fewer data points, and then the group with more data points.
cues.zh: 先串接點數較少的一組，再接點數較多的一組。

cues.en: Now, that means that when we're rank transforming these, we don't have separate ranks for this dataset and this dataset.
cues.zh: 秩轉換時，不是兩組分別排名。

cues.en: It is one set of ranks, but first we list the data with fewer points, and then we list the data with more points.
cues.zh: 只有一組秩，但先列較少點數的資料，再列較多點數的資料。

cues.en: Okay, and then we call the output of the rank function here.
cues.zh: rank 函式的輸出，

cues.en: We're gonna call that r.
cues.zh: 稱為 r。

cues.en: So once we get r, then we're going to compute another quantity called U, and U is equal to simply the sum of all the ranks, except we're not summing up all of the ranks.
cues.zh: 取得 r 後，計算另一個量 U，等於所有秩的總和，不過其實不是全部加總。

cues.en: We are only summing up the ranks that go up to n sub f, which is the sample size from the smaller group.
cues.zh: 只加到 n 下標 f，也就是較小組的樣本數。

cues.en: So it's just the ranks from the smaller group, not the ranks from all of the data.
cues.zh: 所以只取較小組的秩，而非所有資料的秩。

cues.en: And that gives us this variable U, and then this quantity U ends up going into some really obtuse formula
cues.zh: 得到 U，再把它代進一個非常晦澀的公式，

cues.en: that I didn't even feel like writing out in Latech because it was just becoming tedious.
cues.zh: 連用 LaTeX 寫出來都懶，因為太繁瑣。

cues.en: And I've never committed this formula to memory.
cues.zh: 我從來沒有背過。

cues.en: I don't think you should.
cues.zh: 也不認為你該背。

cues.en: So if you're curious, you can look it up online.
cues.zh: 好奇可以上網查。

cues.en: But yeah, just, you know, let the computer do the number crunching here.
cues.zh: 但讓電腦負責數字運算就好。

cues.en: Okay, so U gets into Z.
cues.zh: U 會轉成 Z。

cues.en: And then the interpretation of Z is the same interpretation of the Z for the Wilcoxon signed-rank from a couple videos ago.
cues.zh: Z 的解讀，和幾部前 Wilcoxon 符號等級的 Z 相同。

cues.en: In other words, Z is interpreted as a standard deviation value.
cues.zh: 也就是以標準差單位解讀。

cues.en: It is normally distributed under the non-hypothesis.
cues.zh: 在虛無假設下呈常態分布。

cues.en: So what we do with this Z value is look it up relative, or look it up on a normal distribution, a probability density function from a normal distribution.
cues.zh: 把 Z 值放到常態分布，也就是常態分布的機率密度函數上查詢。

cues.en: And we convert this Z value into a p value, and that is the probability of observing a test statistic this large or larger, given that the null hypothesis is true.
cues.zh: 轉成 P 值，也就是虛無假設為真時，觀察到這麼大或更大檢定統計量的機率。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: The Mann-Whitney U test is a non-parametric alternative to the two-sample unpaired t-test, also called the two-samples independent t-test.
cues.zh: Mann–Whitney U，是不成對雙樣本 t 檢定，也叫獨立雙樣本 t 檢定的無母數替代。
